      "observations": [
        "The patch removes generated SQLite build outputs and creates the test database at runtime from a shared SQL schema. installDBFromFile asynchronously reads SQL and delegates to synchronous installDB; installDB opens the profile DB, creates schema, optionally inserts data, closes the connection, then starts the database service. All changed setup callers use raw SQL or data-only SQL fixtures.",
        "loadExistingDB reaches component registration through MailServices.accounts before obtaining DatabaseCore. Preferences and existing files must be configured before that call. Existing focused startup/registration knowledge is reused; this test refactor is not a universal ban on asynchronous startup.",
        "The changed schema aligns historical fixture tables with production constraints, including UNIQUE(parent,name), and removes fixture STRICT/AUTOINCREMENT assumptions. Current head and production tables/columns track later additions; current production also creates messages_threadId index not present in the checked helper. This static difference is not a measured failure or full schema-equivalence claim.",
        "Lookup/sort test data now resides beside its direct assertions; three remaining external fixtures contain only inserts. Selected current assertions directly cover path/case/Unicode lookup and ordinal/name ordering. This refactor does not independently prove every database API or test run.",
        "The reviewer proposes using production database creation in the future to avoid schema duplication; the actual NotDone request is not implemented by acceptance. Author detaches the patch from larger folder changes, so those linked changes are not audited here."
      ],
